bag.note: The bag was recorded after the distributed controller had already hit its HOME timeout, so /lab/cmd_joint is empty in it; the 6.38 Hz command rate was measured while the controller was active.

engine: ROS 2 Jazzy, real rclpy, Isaac Sim 6.0 ROS 2 bridge

outcome.explanation: The controller node runs on a wall-clock 60 Hz timer while the simulator loop and DDS add latency. The same fixed controller gains that are stable in lockstep localbus overshoot over ROS 2 and hit the HOME state timeout; the transport itself is healthy (60 Hz joint states, ~8 Hz RGB, ~32 ms perception).
